newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures mixed in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mixed in extremely thin after-hours trade on Monday, as sagging prices in rubber producing countries spurred sporadic selling particularly in distant months, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 0.5 firmer than the day"s close. Benchmark July contract was down 0.5 yen at 155.3 yen. Volume was 2,812 lots.

During the day, prices were trapped within tight ranges as a lack of fresh factors thinned volume. "Considering a slim chance that overseas market will rise significantly amid slack demand, prices here are likely to ease," one trader said.
